scenarios.title: POST creates book with all fields
scenarios.given: Book store starts empty in memory.
scenarios.when: POST /books with JSON {'title': 'Dune', 'author': 'Frank Herbert', 'isbn': '978-0441172719', 'synopsis': 'A vast empire and its conflict'}
scenarios.then: Response is 201 with JSON containing id 1, title 'Dune', author 'Frank Herbert', isbn '978-0441172719', synopsis 'A vast empire and its conflict'

scenarios.title: GET returns created book by id
scenarios.given: Book with id 1 exists in memory.
scenarios.then: Response is 200 with JSON matching the stored book with id 1.

scenarios.title: PUT replaces book fields
scenarios.when: PUT /books/1 with JSON {'title': 'Dune 2', 'author': 'Frank Herbert Jr', 'isbn': '978-0441172720', 'synopsis': 'Updated synopsis'}
scenarios.then: Response is 200 with JSON containing title 'Dune 2', author 'Frank Herbert Jr', isbn '978-0441172720', synopsis 'Updated synopsis'

scenarios.title: GET /books lists books ordered by id
scenarios.given: Books with id 1, 2 and 3 exist in memory.
scenarios.then: Response is 200 with JSON array of three books ordered by id 1, 2, 3.

scenarios.title: POST rejects invalid JSON body
scenarios.given: Book store starts empty in memory.
scenarios.when: POST /books with body 'not-json' and Content-Type application/json

scenarios.title: POST rejects missing required field
scenarios.given: Book store starts empty in memory.

scenarios.title: POST rejects id in body
scenarios.given: Book store starts empty in memory.

scenarios.title: PUT rejects non-integer path id
scenarios.given: Book store starts empty in memory.

scenarios.title: GET returns 404 for nonexistent book
scenarios.given: Book store has books but not id 999.

scenarios.title: DELETE returns 404 for nonexistent book
scenarios.given: Book store has books but not id 999.

scenarios.title: POST rejects wrong type field
scenarios.given: Book store starts empty in memory.
